name: Remote Control Kanojo 2 ~Yankee Musume to Onna Kyoushi~
original_name: リモートコントロール彼女2 ヤンキー娘と女教師
source:
Ayazuru is a scientist who works at a certain research institute.
He has developed a special controller that can manipulate human brain waves to freely control body movements.
It was thought to be his invention of the century, but he ended up using the controller to his own desires...

绫鹤是一名在某研究所工作的科学家。他开发出一种特殊控制器，可以操纵人类脑波，自由控制身体动作。

这本应是他一生中最伟大的发明，却最终被他用来满足自己的欲望……
